# EFG Residential Services

> Home improvement & remodeling based in Killeen, Texas. JR and the EFG crew remodel bathrooms, kitchens and fireplaces, put up siding, porches and sheds, and fix plumbing, electrical and HVAC. Reviewers say JR often comes out the same day.

- Phone: (254) 535-9768

- Service area: Killeen, Harker Heights, Copperas Cove, Nolanville, Belton, Fort Cavazos
- Google rating: 4.9 from 182 reviews

## Services
- Bathrooms & walk-in showers: Tub-to-shower conversions and full bathroom remodels, tiled with niches and accent strips.
- Kitchens & backsplashes: Kitchen updates with new counters, sinks and tile backsplashes.
- Fireplaces, floors & paint: Fireplace surrounds and mantels, plank flooring, carpet and interior paint.
- Siding, porches & sheds: Exterior siding, covered porches and new backyard storage sheds.
- Doors & custom carpentry: New doors, door expansions, attic ladders and custom-built furniture.
- Plumbing, electrical & HVAC: Leaks, water heaters, disposals, light fixtures, HVAC and garage door repairs.

## About
EFG Residential Services is a home improvement company with its office at 206 N Gilmer St in Killeen. JR leads the estimates and the work, and reviewers also name crew members Orlando, Eddison and Jesús. The slogan on the logo is simple: Be the Difference. Reviews cover tub-to-shower conversions, full bathroom remodels, fireplace surrounds, kitchen and flooring updates, siding, a covered porch, a dream studio, door expansions and repairs to plumbing, electrical and HVAC. Customers often mention JR coming out the same day or the next, and helping them choose paint, stone, flooring and fixtures.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Can you turn my tub into a walk-in shower?
  A: Yes. It is one of EFG's most common jobs. One family had a tub replaced with a walk-in shower so a parent could bathe more safely.
- Q: How soon can JR come out?
  A: Reviewers describe JR coming out the same day to look at a problem, and one door expansion was finished the day after the visit.
- Q: Do you take small repairs or only remodels?
  A: Both. Reviews mention attic ladders, garbage disposals, light fixtures, plumbing leaks and HVAC fixes alongside full remodels.
- Q: Will you help me pick finishes?
  A: Yes. Customers say JR helped them choose paint, fireplace stone, flooring, carpet and fixtures.
- Q: Where are you based, and where do you work?
  A: The office is at 206 N Gilmer St, Killeen. Crews also work in Harker Heights, Copperas Cove, Belton and nearby.
